summary: Iteration 2 testing of new features (diarize, leaderboard, auto-diarize on analyze, talk_ratio, transcript viewer, copy coaching plan). Backend: ALL 20 tests PASSED (9 baseline + 11 new). Frontend: CRITICAL bug — EvaluationView.jsx is missing required imports (Button, Copy, toast) and never imports/renders TalkRatio or TranscriptViewer. The component throws 'Button is not defined' immediately when rendered, crashing the entire React tree (whitescreen) after Analyze Call. Auto-label-btn works correctly (diarize endpoint integrated). Leaderboard could not be visually verified because the crash unmounts the whole UI shell, but the API and component code look correct.

ui_bugs.issue: Renders <Button> and <Copy> (lucide icon) but never imports them; also calls toast.success/error without importing 'toast' from 'sonner'. Causes 'Button is not defined' page error and unmounts the entire app to a white screen as soon as an Evaluation is shown.

TalkRatio and TranscriptViewer components are NOT imported and NOT rendered anywhere in EvaluationView. The review request states they should appear after analyze (talk-ratio-card, talk-ratio-bar, transcript-viewer data-testids), but these elements never mount. Feature is missing on UI even though backend returns talk_ratio and diarized_transcript correctly.

integration_issues.issue: Backend /api/analyze returns 200 with full payload (incl. diarized_transcript & talk_ratio), but the React tree throws on render so user sees blank page. Analytics tab/Leaderboard cannot be reached afterwards in the same session because the crash unmounts the entire <Dashboard/> including Tabs.

action_items: FIX EvaluationView.jsx imports: add `import { Button } from "../components/ui/button";`, add `Copy` to the existing lucide-react import list, and add `import { toast } from "sonner";`

FIX EvaluationView.jsx feature wiring: import TalkRatio and TranscriptViewer and render them inside the evaluation layout. Suggested: `<TalkRatio ratio={evaluation.talk_ratio} />` next to the Score Breakdown row, and `<TranscriptViewer transcript={evaluation.diarized_transcript || evaluation.transcript} />` as a full-width card at the bottom.

After fix, retest: Analyze a raw transcript -> verify evaluation-view renders, talk-ratio-card/talk-ratio-bar visible with bar reflecting agent_pct/customer_pct, transcript-viewer renders Agent: lines in blue bubbles + Customer: lines in zinc bubbles, copy-coaching-plan-btn copies to clipboard with success toast.
After fix, retest Analytics tab to confirm leaderboard-card and leaderboard-table render with crown icon on top row.
critical_code_review_comments: EvaluationView.jsx: undefined identifiers Button/Copy/toast — ESLint default config did not catch this because react/jsx-no-undef is not configured; consider enabling.

Talk ratio compute_talk_ratio() ignores 'caller'/'client'/'cust' which the regex matches but the if-branch only counts 'agent'/'rep'/'representative' as agent and everything else as customer — currently fine but worth a comment.
extract_json regex `\{.*\}` with DOTALL will greedily match across multiple JSON blobs; works today but fragile.
/api/transcribe-audio: file size check happens AFTER reading entire file into memory — could be a DoS vector for very large uploads.
DIARIZE_SYSTEM_PROMPT relies on LLM not paraphrasing, but for very short raw transcripts the LLM may rewrite — there is no post-validation that the labeled output is a strict superset of the input.
seed_data_creation: Tests created and cleaned up TEST_AutoDiarize and TEST_AlreadyDiarized evaluations; one TEST_E2E_Agent eval was created via UI (analyze succeeded server-side even though UI crashed) — main agent may want to delete from history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully verified (20 pytest tests pass, including diarize, auto-diarize on analyze, talk_ratio math, leaderboard sorted by avg_qa, transcribe-audio validation). Only missing piece is EvaluationView.jsx wiring. After main agent adds the 3 imports and renders <TalkRatio/> + <TranscriptViewer/>, just rerun the playwright smoke flow: load sample -> analyze -> assert talk-ratio-card, talk-ratio-bar, transcript-viewer, copy-coaching-plan-btn are visible; click copy-coaching-plan-btn and assert toast appears; switch to analytics tab and assert leaderboard-card + leaderboard-table.
rca of the issue: Root cause: EvaluationView.jsx was edited to add Copy plan button (uses Button + Copy icon + toast) but the corresponding imports were never added, AND the requested TalkRatio/TranscriptViewer integration was never implemented in this file. As soon as <EvaluationView/> mounts, ReferenceError: Button is not defined is thrown during JSX evaluation (line ~220 where <Button> is used inside the AI Coaching CardHeader). The error propagates up, React unmounts the tree, leaving a blank page. Reproduction: open app -> paste any 10+ char transcript -> click Analyze Call -> wait ~15s -> page goes white. Mitigation: add `import { Button } from "../components/ui/button"`, add `Copy` to the lucide-react import, add `import { toast } from "sonner"`, then import and render TalkRatio + TranscriptViewer.
